name: brownfield
title: Brownfield: add link expiry and custom aliases to the existing service

baseline.hint: Run the greenfield scenario against the same --target first.

impl:T1.rationale: Additive migration appended to the versioned list; upgrade and failure paths proven against real SQLite files.

impl:T2.rationale: Alias rules live next to code generation; the existing minimum-length test is updated on purpose because three-character aliases are now valid codes.

impl:T3.rationale: Expiry is one pure function checked on resolve; aliases are reserved by the primary key so two concurrent requests cannot both win.

impl:T4.rationale: Contract extended with optional fields only, so existing clients are unaffected; new domain errors mapped to 409 and 422.

documentation.rationale: README and changelog updated for expiry and aliases; API reference regenerated from the code.

approvals.comment: Additive migration and lazy expiry are the right call. Approved.
Reviewed migration 2: additive, transactional, app-only rollback. Approved to run.
Regression suite green after one rework round; migration tested on v1 data. Promote.

faults.note: Seeded off-by-one at the expiry boundary in the first implementation attempt, to exercise test failure -> rollback -> targeted rework.
